notes: Independent review: partition, edges, heads, statuses all confirmed. 29 single-morpheme units cover s001-s029 and t001-t035 exactly once, with no unrepresented or added remainder. Supplied 'them' stays inside the hachayot unit as the Hiphil's licensed object rather than 'added' (rule 30). The one contestable head is hachayot: 'alive' carries the root chayah but 'keep' carries the Hiphil causation, a genuine tie broken toward the predicate 'keep' by rule 24.
